## 2. Block Registration Patterns

### PHP Registration (greenlightaddon.php)

```php
<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: GreenLight Boilerplate Addon
 * Version: 0.1
 */

// Exit if accessed directly
if (!defined('ABSPATH')) {
    exit;
}

// Define constants
define('GREENLIGHTADDON_DIR_URL', plugin_dir_url(__FILE__));
define('GREENLIGHTADDON_DIR_PATH', plugin_dir_path(__FILE__));

// Dependency check for parent plugin
function gspb_greenLightAddon_is_parent_active() {
    $active_plugins = get_option('active_plugins', array());
    if (is_multisite()) {
        $network_active_plugins = get_site_option('active_sitewide_plugins', array());
        $active_plugins = array_merge($active_plugins, array_keys($network_active_plugins));
    }
    foreach ($active_plugins as $basename) {
        if (
            0 === strpos($basename, 'gl-page-builder/') || 
            0 === strpos($basename, 'greenshift-animation-and-page-builder-blocks/')
        ) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

// Conditional loading based on parent plugin
if (gspb_greenLightAddon_is_parent_active()) {
    add_action('enqueue_block_editor_assets', 'greenLightAddon_editor_assets');
} else {
    add_action('admin_notices', 'gspb_greenLightAddon_admin_notice_warning');
}

// Block category registration
add_filter('block_categories_all', 'gspb_greenLightAddon_category', 1, 2);
function gspb_greenLightAddon_category($categories, $post) {
    return array_merge(
        array(
            array(
                'slug'  => 'greenLightAddon',
                'title' => __('GreenLight Addon'),
            ),
        ),
        $categories
    );
}

// Editor assets enqueue
function greenLightAddon_editor_assets() {
    $index_asset_file = include(GREENLIGHTADDON_DIR_PATH . 'build/index.asset.php');

    // Scripts - CRITICAL: depends on greenShift-editor-js and greenShift-library-script
    wp_enqueue_script(
        'greenLightAddon-block-js',
        GREENLIGHTADDON_DIR_URL . 'build/index.js',
        array(
            'greenShift-editor-js', 
            'greenShift-library-script', 
            'wp-block-editor', 
            'wp-blocks', 
            'wp-i18n', 
            'wp-element', 
            'wp-editor', 
            'wp-data'
        ),
        rand(1, 9999),
        true
    );

    // Styles
    wp_enqueue_style(
        'greenLightAddon-block-css',
        GREENLIGHTADDON_DIR_URL . 'build/index.css',
        array('greenShift-library-editor', 'wp-edit-blocks'),
        $index_asset_file['version']
    );
}

// Include server-side render files
require_once GREENLIGHTADDON_DIR_PATH . 'blockrender/example/block.php';

// Conditional scripts filter for frontend
add_filter('render_block', 'greenLightAddon_block_script_assets', 10, 2);
function greenLightAddon_block_script_assets($html, $block) {
    if (!is_admin()) {
        // Add conditional frontend script loading here
    }
    return $html;
}
```

## 4. Block Structure Patterns

### attributes.js - Greenshift Attribute Schema

```javascript
const { collectionsObjects } = gspblib.helpers;

export default {
    // CORE ID SYSTEM - Always required
    id: {
        type: 'string',
        default: null,
    },
    localId: {
        type: 'string',
    },
    staticLocalId: {
        type: 'boolean',
    },
    localClassInstance: {
        type: 'string',
    },
    anchor: {
        type: 'string',
    },
    
    // STYLE SYSTEM - Critical for Greenshift styling
    inlineCssStyles: {
        type: 'string',
    },
    styleAttributes: {
        type: 'object',
    },
    enableSpecificity: {
        type: 'boolean',
    },
    
    // DYNAMIC CLASSES - For global class system
    dynamicGClasses: {
        type: "array",
    },
    
    // ANIMATION SYSTEM
    interactionLayers: {
        type: "array",
    },
    animation: {
        type: 'object',
        default: collectionsObjects.animation,
    },
    
    // BLOCK-SPECIFIC CONTENT
    textContent: {
        type: 'string',
        default: '',
        role: "content"  // Important for content patterns
    },
    
    // COMPONENTS
    icon: {
        type: 'object',
    },
    
    // STANDARD WP
    className: {
        type: 'string',
    },
    
    // CUSTOM PROPERTIES EXAMPLE
    color: {
        type: 'string',
    },
    unitArray: {
        type: 'array',  // [desktop, tablet, mobile-landscape, mobile-portrait]
    },
};
```

### edit.js - Complete Editor Component Pattern

```javascript
// WordPress dependencies
const { __ } = wp.i18n;
const { useRef, useEffect } = wp.element;
const { RichText, useBlockProps } = wp.blockEditor;

// Greenlight dependencies - CRITICAL IMPORTS
const { gspb_setBlockId, getDataAttributesfromDynamic } = gspblib.utilities;
const {
    aos_animation_cssGen,
    gspb_Css_Final,
    getFinalCssFromDynamicLocalClasses,
    getCssFromStyleAttributes,
} = gspblib.utilities;
const { gspb_cssGen } = gspblib.helpers;
const { BlockToolBar } = gspblib.components;
const { AnimationRenderProps } = gspblib.collections;
const { AnimationWrapper } = gspblib.collections;
const { gspb_convert_styles_for_editor } = gspblib.helpers;
const { SVGViewer } = gspblib.components;

import Inspector from './inspector';

export default function edit(props) {
    const {
        id,
        localId,
        animation,
        styleAttributes,
        textContent,
        enableSpecificity,
        color,
        unitArray,
        interactionLayers,
        anchor,
        icon
    } = props.attributes;

    // =====================
    // 1. ID GENERATION
    // =====================
    useEffect(() => {
        gspb_setBlockId(props, 2);  // 2 = prefix length
    }, []);

    // =====================
    // 2. LOCAL ID (ROOT CLASS) MANAGEMENT
    // =====================
    useEffect(() => {
        if (id != null) {
            if (props.attributes.localId && props.attributes.localId == id) {
                // do nothing
            } else {
                if (props.attributes.staticLocalId && props.attributes.localId) {
                    // do nothing - preserve static localId
                } else {
                    props.setAttributes({ localId: id });
                }
            }
        }
    }, [id]);

    // =====================
    // 3. ICON HANDLING
    // =====================
    let iconBox = icon ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(icon)) : null;

    // =====================
    // 4. ANIMATION SETUP
    // =====================
    const animationRef = useRef();
    let AnimationProps = {};
    AnimationProps = AnimationRenderProps(animation, interactionLayers);

    // =====================
    // 5. DYNAMIC DATA ATTRIBUTES
    // =====================
    let DynamicDataAttributes = getDataAttributesfromDynamic(props);

    // =====================
    // 6. BLOCK PROPS
    // =====================
    let blockProps = useBlockProps({
        "data-gspb-block-id": props.attributes.id,
        className: `gspb-selector-element ${localId ? localId : ''}`,
        ref: animationRef,
        ...DynamicDataAttributes,
        ...AnimationProps
    });

    // =====================
    // 7. CSS GENERATION PIPELINE
    // =====================
    let css_selector_by_user = '.' + localId;
    let final_css = '';

    // 7a. Dynamic Local Classes CSS
    final_css = getFinalCssFromDynamicLocalClasses(props, final_css);

    // 7b. Style Attributes CSS
    let local_css = '';
    if (styleAttributes) {
        local_css = getCssFromStyleAttributes(
            styleAttributes, 
            css_selector_by_user, 
            local_css, 
            enableSpecificity
        );
    }
    if (local_css != '') {
        final_css += local_css;
    }

    // 7c. Animation CSS
    final_css = aos_animation_cssGen(
        animation,
        css_selector_by_user,
        final_css,
        props
    );

    // 7d. Device-Responsive Custom CSS (4 breakpoints)
    final_css = gspb_cssGen(
        css_selector_by_user,
        ['font-size'],
        [
            [
                [(unitArray && unitArray[0]) ? unitArray[0] : null],  // Desktop
                [(unitArray && unitArray[1]) ? unitArray[1] : null],  // Tablet
                [(unitArray && unitArray[2]) ? unitArray[2] : null],  // Mobile Landscape
                [(unitArray && unitArray[3]) ? unitArray[3] : null],  // Mobile Portrait
            ],
        ],
        final_css
    );

    // 7e. Non-Responsive Custom CSS
    final_css = gspb_cssGen(
        css_selector_by_user,
        ['color'],
        [color],
        final_css
    );

    // =====================
    // 8. ELEMENT TAG & ANCHOR
    // =====================
    let ElementTag = 'div';
    if (anchor) {
        blockProps.id = anchor;
    }

    // =====================
    // 9. EDITOR CSS CONVERSION
    // =====================
    let editor_css = final_css;
    editor_css = gspb_convert_styles_for_editor(editor_css);

    // =====================
    // 10. STORE FINAL CSS
    // =====================
    gspb_Css_Final(id, final_css, props);

    // =====================
    // 11. RENDER
    // =====================
    return (
        <>
            <AnimationWrapper 
                attributes={props.attributes} 
                props={props} 
                animationExtRef={animationRef}
            >
                {props.isSelected && (
                    <>
                        <Inspector {...props} />
                        <BlockToolBar {...props} />
                    </>
                )}
                <ElementTag {...blockProps}>
                    <RichText
                        tagName={'span'}
                        placeholder={__("Greenlight - Page-Building Gutenberg Blocks", 'greenlightaddon')}
                        value={textContent}
                        onChange={(value) => {
                            props.setAttributes({ textContent: value });
                        }}
                    />
                    {iconBox && (
                        <SVGViewer 
                            attributeName="icon" 
                            blockProps={blockProps} 
                            {...props} 
                        />
                    )}
                    {editor_css && (
                        <style
                            dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
                                __html: editor_css,
                            }}
                        />
                    )}
                </ElementTag>
            </AnimationWrapper>
        </>
    );
}
```

### save.js - Frontend Save Component

```javascript
const { __ } = wp.i18n;
const { RichText } = wp.blockEditor;
import isEqual from 'lodash/isEqual';
import attributes from './attributes';

const { getDataAttributesfromDynamic } = gspblib.utilities;
const { AnimationRenderProps } = gspblib.collections;
const { SVGViewer } = gspblib.components;

export default function save(props) {
    const {
        anchor,
        textContent,
        localId,
        animation,
        interactionLayers,
        styleAttributes,
    } = props.attributes;

    let DynamicDataAttributes = getDataAttributesfromDynamic(props);

    let AnimationProps = {};
    AnimationProps = AnimationRenderProps(animation, interactionLayers);

    let ElementTag = 'div';
    const blockProps = {
        ...DynamicDataAttributes,
        ...AnimationProps,
        className: props.attributes.className || null,
    };

    // CRITICAL: Only add localId class if styles exist
    if (localId && (styleAttributes || !isEqual(animation, attributes.animation.default))) {
        if (blockProps.className) {
            blockProps.className = blockProps.className + ' ' + localId;
        } else {
            blockProps.className = localId;
        }
    }

    if (anchor) {
        blockProps.id = anchor;
    }

    return (
        <>
            <ElementTag {...blockProps}>
                <RichText.Content value={textContent} />
                <SVGViewer 
                    attributeName="icon" 
                    attributeText="textPathAttributes" 
                    blockProps={blockProps} 
                    {...props} 
                />
            </ElementTag>
        </>
    );
}
```

### render.php (blockrender/example/block.php) - Server-Side Rendering

```php
<?php

namespace greenlightaddon\Blocks;
defined('ABSPATH') OR exit;

class Renderbox {

    public function __construct() {
        add_action('init', array($this, 'init_handler'));
    }

    public function init_handler() {
        register_block_type(__DIR__, array(
            'render_callback' => array($this, 'render_block'),
        ));
    }

    public function render_block($settings, $inner_content, $block) {
        $block = (is_array($block)) ? $block : $block->parsed_block;
        $html = $inner_content;

        // Hide on Frontend option
        if (!empty($block['attrs']['styleAttributes']['hideOnFrontend_Extra'])) {
            if (!is_admin()) {
                return '';
            }
        }

        // Polyfills for CSS features
        if (!empty($block['attrs']['styleAttributes']['animationTimeline'])) {
            wp_enqueue_script('scroll-view-polyfill');
        }
        if (!empty($block['attrs']['styleAttributes']['anchorName'])) {
            wp_enqueue_script('anchor-polyfill');
        }

        // Dynamic placeholders processing
        if (!empty($block['attrs']['textContent'])) {
            if (strpos($block['attrs']['textContent'], '{{') !== false) {
                $html = gl_dynamic_placeholders($html);
            }
        }

        return $html;
    }
}

new Renderbox;
```

## 5. Greenshift-Specific Conventions

### ID Generation Pattern

```javascript
// In edit.js useEffect - generates unique block ID
useEffect(() => {
    gspb_setBlockId(props, 2);  // 2 = prefix length for ID
}, []);

// localId management - CSS class that can be shared across blocks
useEffect(() => {
    if (id != null) {
        if (props.attributes.localId && props.attributes.localId == id) {
            // Already set correctly
        } else {
            if (props.attributes.staticLocalId && props.attributes.localId) {
                // Preserve static localId
            } else {
                props.setAttributes({ localId: id });
            }
        }
    }
}, [id]);
```

### styleAttributes Structure

The `styleAttributes` object stores CSS properties in arrays with 4 indices for responsive breakpoints:

```javascript
styleAttributes: {
    fontSize: ['24px', '20px', '18px', '16px'],  // [desktop, tablet, mobile-landscape, mobile-portrait]
    color: ['#000000', null, null, null],         // Only desktop defined
    margin: ['20px', '15px', '10px', '5px'],
    customCSS_Extra: '.selector { ... }'          // Custom CSS string
}
```

### CSS Rendering Pipeline

```javascript
// 1. Selector based on localId
let css_selector_by_user = '.' + localId;
let final_css = '';

// 2. Dynamic Local Classes (from Class Panel)
final_css = getFinalCssFromDynamicLocalClasses(props, final_css);

// 3. Style Attributes (from AttributeTabs)
if (styleAttributes) {
    local_css = getCssFromStyleAttributes(
        styleAttributes, 
        css_selector_by_user, 
        local_css, 
        enableSpecificity  // Adds higher specificity if true
    );
}

// 4. Animation CSS
final_css = aos_animation_cssGen(animation, css_selector_by_user, final_css, props);

// 5. Custom responsive CSS using gspb_cssGen
// For RESPONSIVE properties (4 breakpoint values):
final_css = gspb_cssGen(
    css_selector_by_user,
    ['font-size', 'padding'],  // CSS properties array
    [
        [
            [desktop_val],
            [tablet_val],
            [mobile_landscape_val],
            [mobile_portrait_val]
        ],
        // ... more property values
    ],
    final_css
);

// For NON-RESPONSIVE properties (single value):
final_css = gspb_cssGen(
    css_selector_by_user,
    ['color', 'background'],
    [colorValue, bgValue],  // Single values, not arrays
    final_css
);

// 6. Convert for editor display
let editor_css = gspb_convert_styles_for_editor(final_css);

// 7. Store final CSS for frontend output
gspb_Css_Final(id, final_css, props);
```

## 6. Inspector Component Pattern

```javascript
const { __ } = wp.i18n;
const { InspectorControls } = wp.blockEditor;
const { PanelBody, TextareaControl, Popover } = wp.components;
const { useState } = wp.element;
import isEqual from 'lodash/isEqual';
import attributesDefault from './attributes';

// Greenshift Components
const {
    Animation,
    InteractionsPanel,
    IconPicker,
    AttributeTabs
} = gspblib.collections;
const { BlpgeColorPicker, UnitControl, GlobalClasses } = gspblib.components;
const { collectionsObjects } = gspblib.helpers;
const { gspb_getDeviceStateIndex } = gspblib.utilities;
const { Devices } = gspblib.components;
const { gspb_inherit_values } = gspblib.helpers;

const Inspector = (props) => {
    const {
        attributes: {
            textContent,
            anchor,
            styleAttributes,
            icon,
            localId,
            staticLocalId,
            enableSpecificity,
            color,
            unitArray,
        },
        setAttributes,
    } = props;

    const deviceStateIndex = gspb_getDeviceStateIndex();
    const [devstate, setdevState] = useState(0);

    // Change detection for panel highlighting
    let animationchange = isEqual(attributesDefault.animation.default, props.attributes.animation) 
        ? false : true;
    let interactionchange = (typeof props.attributes.interactionLayers != 'undefined' 
        && props.attributes.interactionLayers.length > 0) ? true : false;

    return (
        <InspectorControls>
            <div className="gspb_inspector gst-elements-inspector glfw-inspector">
                
                {/* Global Classes Panel */}
                <GlobalClasses flexChild={true} {...props} />

                {/* Local Styles Panel with AttributeTabs */}
                <PanelBody title={__("Local Styles", 'greenlightaddon')} initialOpen={true}>
                    <AttributeTabs
                        attributeName="styleAttributes"
                        {...props}
                        defaultTab={''}
                        includes={[
                            'typography', 'color', 'spacing', 'shadow', 
                            'border', 'position', 'size', 'layout', 
                            'effects', 'csstransform', 'responsive'
                        ]} 
                        svgcolors={true} 
                        selfAlign={"both"}
                    />
                </PanelBody>

                {/* Extra Components with Device Selector */}
                <PanelBody title={__("Extra Components", 'greenlightaddon')}>
                    <div style={{ justifyContent: "flex-end", marginBottom: 10, display: "flex" }}>
                        <Devices className="" onChange={() => setdevState(!devstate)} />
                    </div>
                    
                    {/* Color Picker */}
                    <BlpgeColorPicker
                        color={color}
                        onChange={(value) => setAttributes({ color: value })}
                    />
                    
                    {/* Responsive Unit Control */}
                    <UnitControl
                        value={gspb_inherit_values(unitArray, deviceStateIndex)}
                        onChange={(value) => {
                            let currentValue = unitArray ? unitArray.slice() : [];
                            currentValue[deviceStateIndex] = value;
                            setAttributes({ unitArray: currentValue });
                        }}
                    />
                </PanelBody>

                {/* Animation Panel */}
                <PanelBody 
                    title={__("Animation", 'greenlightaddon')}
                    className={`${!animationchange ? '' : 'gspb_panel_changed'}`}
                >
                    <Animation attributeName="animation" {...props} />
                </PanelBody>

                {/* Interaction Layers */}
                <PanelBody 
                    title={__("Interaction Layers", 'greenlightaddon')}
                    className={`${interactionchange ? 'gspb_panel_changed' : ''}`}
                >
                    <InteractionsPanel {...props} />
                </PanelBody>

            </div>
        </InspectorControls>
    );
};

export default Inspector;
```

## 7. Key Greenshift Library (gspblib) APIs

### Utilities (gspblib.utilities)

| Function | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `gspb_setBlockId(props, prefix)` | Generates unique block ID |
| `getDataAttributesfromDynamic(props)` | Gets data attributes from dynamic class panel |
| `getFinalCssFromDynamicLocalClasses(props, css)` | CSS from dynamic global classes |
| `getCssFromStyleAttributes(attrs, selector, css, specificity)` | CSS from styleAttributes |
| `aos_animation_cssGen(animation, selector, css, props)` | Animation keyframes CSS |
| `gspb_Css_Final(id, css, props)` | Stores CSS for frontend output |
| `gspb_getDeviceStateIndex()` | Gets current device breakpoint index (0-3) |

### Helpers (gspblib.helpers)

| Function | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `gspb_cssGen(selector, properties, values, css)` | Generates CSS with media queries |
| `gspb_convert_styles_for_editor(css)` | Converts CSS for editor scoping |
| `gspb_inherit_values(array, deviceIndex)` | Gets value with inheritance fallback |
| `collectionsObjects` | Default attribute objects (animation, etc.) |

| Component | Purpose |

## 8. Dependency Checking Pattern

```php
// In main plugin file
function gspb_greenLightAddon_is_parent_active() {
    $active_plugins = get_option('active_plugins', array());

    // Support for multisite network-activated plugins
    if (is_multisite()) {
        $network_active_plugins = get_site_option('active_sitewide_plugins', array());
        $active_plugins = array_merge($active_plugins, array_keys($network_active_plugins));
    }

    // Check for either GreenLight or Greenshift parent plugins
    foreach ($active_plugins as $basename) {
        if (
            0 === strpos($basename, 'gl-page-builder/') || 
            0 === strpos($basename, 'greenshift-animation-and-page-builder-blocks/')
        ) {
            return true;
        }
    }

    return false;
}

// Conditional loading
if (gspb_greenLightAddon_is_parent_active()) {
    add_action('enqueue_block_editor_assets', 'greenLightAddon_editor_assets');
} else {
    add_action('admin_notices', 'gspb_greenLightAddon_admin_notice_warning');
}

// Warning notice
function gspb_greenLightAddon_admin_notice_warning() {
    ?>
    <div class="notice notice-warning">
        <p><?php printf(
            __('Please, activate %s plugin to use Boilerplate Addon'), 
            '<a href="https://greenlightbuilder.pro" target="_blank">GreenLight Builder</a>'
        ); ?></p>
    </div>
    <?php
}

## React Rooter Analysis Summary

### 1. What React Rooter Does and Its Purpose

**React Rooter** is a WordPress plugin that enables developers to embed React applications directly into WordPress pages via a Gutenberg block. It provides:

- A simple way to mount React 18 applications within WordPress content
- Both frontend and backend (editor) React component rendering
- Hot-reload development support for faster iteration
- Multiple React instance support on a single page

The library acts as a **bridge between WordPress's block ecosystem and React**, allowing developers to write modern React components that render seamlessly within WordPress.

### 2. How It Integrates React Components with WordPress

**Architecture Overview:**

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `index.js` | Registers the WordPress block using `registerBlockType()` |
| `edit.js` | Renders React components in the block editor (backend) |
| `save.js` | Outputs a minimal DOM placeholder (empty `<div>` with unique ID) |
| `view.js` | Mounts React components on the frontend after page load |
| `App.js` | The actual React application/component |

**Key Integration Pattern:**

```javascript
// save.js - Creates a placeholder div
export default function save({ attributes }) {
  const { blockId } = attributes;
  const blockProps = useBlockProps.save();
  blockProps.id = blockId || 'react-rooter-init';
  return <div {...blockProps} />;
}
```

```javascript
// view.js - Hydrates React on frontend
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import App from './App';

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const blocks = document.querySelectorAll('[id^="react-rooter-"]');
  blocks.forEach((block) => {
    const root = createRoot(block);
    root.render(React.createElement(App));
  });
});
```

### 3. Key Patterns for Using in Greenshift Blocks

Based on comparing React Rooter with your existing Greenshift addon at `/Users/scottfoster/git/altitude-blocks/`, here are the key integration patterns:

#### Pattern A: Block ID Generation
React Rooter generates unique IDs using the WordPress `clientId`:

```javascript
// edit.js
useEffect(() => {
  if (!blockId) {
    const newBlockId = `react-rooter-${clientId.slice(0, 8)}`;
    setAttributes({ blockId: newBlockId });
  }
}, []);
```

Your Greenshift blocks use a similar pattern with `gspb_setBlockId()`:

```javascript
// Your existing pattern in edit.js
useEffect(() => {
  gspb_setBlockId(props, 2);
}, []);
```

#### Pattern B: Frontend Script Loading
In `block.json`, React Rooter specifies:

```json
{
  "viewScript": "./view.js"
}
```

This ensures the frontend mounting script only loads when the block is present on the page.

#### Pattern C: Selector Pattern for Multiple Instances
React Rooter uses CSS attribute selectors to find all block instances:

```javascript
document.querySelectorAll('[id^="react-rooter-"]')
```

For Greenshift, you would use:

```javascript
document.querySelectorAll('[data-gspb-block-id]')
```

### 4. Initialization/Setup Requirements

**PHP Registration (minimal):**
```php
function create_react_root_block__block_init() {
    register_block_type( __DIR__ . '/build' );
}
add_action( 'init', 'create_react_root_block__block_init' );
```

**Block.json Configuration:**
```json
{
  "apiVersion": 3,
  "name": "greenlight/react-rooter",
  "viewScript": "./view.js",
  "editorScript": "./index.js",
  "style": "./style-index.css",
  "attributes": {
    "blockId": { "type": "string" }
  }
}
```

### 5. Component Mounting/Unmounting

**Mounting (React 18 pattern):**
```javascript
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const blocks = document.querySelectorAll('[id^="react-rooter-"]');
  blocks.forEach((block) => {
    const root = createRoot(block);
    root.render(React.createElement(App));
  });
});
```

**For proper unmounting**, you would need to track roots and call `root.unmount()`:

```javascript
// If you need cleanup (e.g., for SPAs or dynamic content)
const roots = new Map();

function mountBlocks() {
  const blocks = document.querySelectorAll('[id^="react-rooter-"]');
  blocks.forEach((block) => {
    if (!roots.has(block.id)) {
      const root = createRoot(block);
      root.render(React.createElement(App));
      roots.set(block.id, root);
    }
  });
}

function unmountBlock(blockId) {
  const root = roots.get(blockId);
  if (root) {
    root.unmount();
    roots.delete(blockId);
  }
}
```

## How to Use React Rooter Pattern in a Greenshift Addon Block

Here is a practical implementation approach for your `/Users/scottfoster/git/altitude-blocks/` project:

### Step 1: Create a New Block with React Frontend

**File Structure:**
```
src/blocks/react-component/
  |-- index.js          # Block registration
  |-- edit.js           # Editor component (use gspblib)
  |-- save.js           # Outputs placeholder div
  |-- view.js           # Frontend React mounting
  |-- App.js            # Your React application
  |-- attributes.js     # Block attributes
blockrender/react-component/
  |-- block.json        # Block metadata with viewScript
  |-- block.php         # PHP render callback (optional)
```

### Step 2: Configure block.json

```json
{
  "apiVersion": 2,
  "name": "greenlightaddon/react-component",
  "title": "React Component",
  "category": "greenLightAddon",
  "textdomain": "greenlightaddon",
  "editorStyle": "greenLightAddon-block-css",
  "viewScript": "file:./view.js",
  "attributes": {
    "id": { "type": "string" },
    "localId": { "type": "string" },
    "blockId": { "type": "string" }
  }
}
```

### Step 3: Create save.js (Placeholder Output)

```javascript
import { useBlockProps } from '@wordpress/block-editor';

export default function save({ attributes }) {
  const { id, localId } = attributes;
  const blockProps = useBlockProps.save({
    'data-gspb-block-id': id,
    className: `gspb-selector-element ${localId || ''}`,
  });
  
  // Output empty div - React will hydrate this
  return <div {...blockProps} />;
}
```

### Step 4: Create view.js (Frontend Mounting)

```javascript
import React from 'react';
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import App from './App';

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const blocks = document.querySelectorAll('.greenlightaddon-react-component');
  
  blocks.forEach((block) => {
    const blockId = block.dataset.gspbBlockId;
    const root = createRoot(block);
    
    // Pass block data as props to React component
    root.render(
      React.createElement(App, {
        blockId: blockId,
        // Add any other data attributes as props
      })
    );
  });
});
```

### Step 5: Update Main Plugin to Enqueue View Script

In `/Users/scottfoster/git/altitude-blocks/greenlightaddon.php`, modify the `greenLightAddon_block_script_assets` filter:

```php
function greenLightAddon_block_script_assets($html, $block) {
    if (!is_admin()) {
        if ($block['blockName'] === 'greenlightaddon/react-component') {
            wp_enqueue_script(
                'greenlight-react-view',
                GREENLIGHTADDON_DIR_URL . 'build/react-component-view.js',
                array('wp-element'),
                filemtime(GREENLIGHTADDON_DIR_PATH . 'build/react-component-view.js'),
                true
            );
        }
    }
    return $html;
}
```

## Key Takeaways

1. **React Rooter uses a hydration pattern** - The save function outputs a minimal placeholder, and the view script mounts React after DOM load.

2. **Unique IDs are critical** - Each block instance needs a unique identifier to support multiple instances on a page.

3. **Greenshift already has robust ID handling** - The `gspb_setBlockId()` utility and `data-gspb-block-id` attribute align well with React Rooter's approach.

4. **viewScript in block.json** - This is the cleanest way to conditionally load frontend React code only when the block is used.

5. **React 18's createRoot API** - React Rooter uses the modern `createRoot()` instead of the legacy `ReactDOM.render()`, which is important for concurrent features.

### 5. Server-Side Rendering Patterns

**PHP Block Class Pattern** (`/blockrender/smartcode/block.php`):
```php
namespace Greenshift\Blocks;
defined('ABSPATH') OR exit;

class SmartCode {
    
    public function __construct(){
        add_action('init', array($this, 'init_handler'));
    }

    public function init_handler(){
        register_block_type(__DIR__, array(
            'render_callback' => array($this, 'render_block'),
            'attributes'      => $this->attributes
        ));
    }

    public $attributes = array(
        'htmlcontent' => array('type' => 'string', 'default' => ""),
        'csscontent' => array('type' => 'string', 'default' => ""),
        'scriptcontent' => array('type' => 'string', 'default' => ""),
    );

    public function render_block($settings = array(), $inner_content=''){
        extract($settings);

        $blockClassName = 'gspb-smartcode '.(!empty($className) ? $className : '');
        $out = '<div class="'.$blockClassName.'">';
        $out .= $htmlcontent;
        $out .='</div>';

        // Inline CSS via wp_add_inline_style
        if (!empty($csscontent)) {
            $cssContent = wp_strip_all_tags($csscontent);
            wp_register_style('smartcode', false);
            wp_enqueue_style('smartcode');
            wp_add_inline_style('smartcode', $cssContent);
        }

        // Inline JS via wp_add_inline_script
        if (!empty($scriptcontent)) {
            $scriptcontent = wp_strip_all_tags($scriptcontent);
            wp_register_script('smartcode', '', array(), '', true);
            wp_enqueue_script('smartcode');
            wp_add_inline_script('smartcode', $scriptcontent);
        }

        return $out;
    }
}

new SmartCode;
```

**Block Filter for Dynamic Assets** (main plugin file):
```php
add_filter('render_block', 'greenShiftAi_block_script_assets', 10, 2);

function greenShiftAi_block_script_assets($html, $block) {
    if(!is_admin()){
        if ($block['blockName'] == 'greenshift-blocks/smartcode') {
            // Conditionally enqueue based on block attributes
            if(!empty($block['attrs']['scriptcontent'])){
                wp_enqueue_script('gs-smartcode-ai-code');
                $scriptcontent = wp_strip_all_tags($block['attrs']['scriptcontent']);
                wp_add_inline_script('gs-smartcode-ai-code', $scriptcontent);
            }
            if(!empty($block['attrs']['csscontent'])){
                wp_enqueue_style('gs-smartcode-ai-code');
                $csscontent = wp_strip_all_tags($block['attrs']['csscontent']);
                wp_add_inline_style('gs-smartcode-ai-code', $csscontent);
            }
        }
    }
    return $html;
}
```

---

### Useful Patterns for Custom Blocks

1. **Attribute Collection Objects**: Define shared object defaults for reusable design attributes (spacing, border, background)

2. **CSS Generator Chain**: Build CSS incrementally using chained generator functions for each attribute type

3. **Change Detection**: Use `lodash/isEqual` to compare current values with defaults for UI highlighting

4. **Tabbed Inspector**: Organize settings into "General" and "Advanced" tabs

5. **Block Toolbar with Multiple Modes**: Use ToolbarButtons to switch between different editing modes (HTML, CSS, Script, Preview, AI)

6. **Inline Style/Script Injection**: Use `wp_add_inline_style` and `wp_add_inline_script` for block-specific assets

7. **Conditional Asset Loading**: Use `render_block` filter to load assets only when block attributes require them

8. **PHP Execution via Custom Post Type**: Store executable PHP code in a custom post type for security, then render via shortcode

9. **Streaming AI Responses**: Use fetch with ReadableStream for real-time AI response display with abort capability

## Greenshift Developer Documentation Analysis

### 1. PHP Filter Signatures and Expected Array Formats

#### Preset Class Filters (for adding to existing groups)

There are **seven category-specific filters** for adding preset classes to existing groups:

| Filter Name | Purpose |
|------------|---------|
| `greenshift_style_preset_classes` | Style-related presets |
| `greenshift_interaction_preset_classes` | Interaction presets |
| `greenshift_spacing_preset_classes` | Spacing presets |
| `greenshift_shadow_preset_classes` | Shadow presets |
| `greenshift_border_preset_classes` | Border presets |
| `greenshift_background_preset_classes` | Background presets |
| `greenshift_data_preset_classes` | Data presets |

**Filter Signature:**
```php
add_filter('greenshift_{category}_preset_classes', 'callback_function');
function callback_function($options) {
    // $options is an array of existing preset classes
    // Add new items and return the modified array
    return $options;
}
```

#### Group-Level Filters (for creating new groups)

| Filter Name | Purpose |
|------------|---------|
| `greenshift_preset_classes` | Create custom preset groups |
| `greenshift_framework_classes` | Create custom framework groups |

### 3. How to Register Preset Classes (`greenshift_preset_classes` filter)

#### Adding to Existing Preset Groups

```php
add_filter('greenshift_style_preset_classes', 'custom_style_classes');
function custom_style_classes($options) {
    $options[] = [
        'value' => 'mb10',
        'label' => "Margin Bottom 10px",
        'type'  => "preset",
        'css'   => ".mb10{margin-bottom:10px}"
    ];
    return $options;
}
```

#### Creating a New Preset Group

```php
add_filter('greenshift_preset_classes', 'custom_preset_group');
function custom_preset_group($options) {
    return array(
        array(
            'label'   => esc_html__('Custom Presets', 'textdomain'),
            'options' => array(
                [
                    'value' => 'mb10',
                    'label' => "Margin Bottom 10px",
                    'type'  => "preset",
                    'css'   => ".mb10{margin-bottom:10px}"
                ],
                [
                    'value' => 'mb20',
                    'label' => "Margin Bottom 20px",
                    'type'  => "preset",
                    'css'   => ".mb20{margin-bottom:20px}"
                ]
            )
        )
    );
}
```

---

### 4. Block Registration Requirements

#### Block Attribute Structure

Blocks require these key attributes:

| Attribute | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `id` | Unique identifier for the block |
| `inlineCssStyles` | Pre-rendered CSS declarations (Method 1) |
| `styleAttributes` | Camelcase style object for responsive design |
| `CSSRender` | Flag enabling server-side rendering (set to `1`) |
| `tag` | HTML element type (defaults to `div`) |

#### Method 1: Inline CSS Styles

```json
{
    "id": "unique-block-id",
    "inlineCssStyles": ".gsbp-2f32680{background-color:#c44242;color:#ffffff;}"
}
```

#### Method 2: Server-Side Rendering (Recommended)

```json
{
    "id": "unique-block-id",
    "CSSRender": 1,
    "styleAttributes": {
        "backgroundColor": "#c44242",
        "color": "#ffffff"
    }
}
```

#### Style Attributes Format

The `styleAttributes` object uses **camelCase syntax** with array values supporting responsive breakpoints:

- Array can have up to **4 values** representing: desktop, tablet, mobile landscape, mobile portrait
- Use `null` for skipped breakpoints

```json
{
    "styleAttributes": {
        "padding": ["20px", "15px", "10px", "8px"],
        "fontSize": ["18px", "16px", null, "14px"]
    }
}
```

---

### 5. CSS Framework Registration Patterns

#### Preset Class Array Structure (with CSS)

```php
[
    'value' => 'gs_border_elegant',
    'label' => "Border Elegant",
    'css'   => ".gs_border_elegant{border:1px solid #00000012}",
    'type'  => "preset"
]
```

#### Framework Class Array Structure (without CSS - loaded independently)

```php
[
    'value' => 'mb10',
    'label' => "Margin Bottom 10px",
    'type'  => "framework"
]
```

#### Creating a Custom Framework Group

```php
add_filter('greenshift_framework_classes', 'custom_framework_group');
function custom_framework_group($options) {
    return array(
        array(
            'label'   => esc_html__('Custom Framework', 'textdomain'),
            'options' => array(
                ['value' => 'mb10', 'label' => "Margin Bottom 10px", 'type' => "framework"],
                ['value' => 'mb20', 'label' => "Margin Bottom 20px", 'type' => "framework"]
            )
        )
    );
}
```

---

### 6. Complete Code Examples

#### Example 1: Register Multiple Preset Classes in an Existing Group

```php
add_filter('greenshift_spacing_preset_classes', 'my_spacing_presets');
function my_spacing_presets($options) {
    // Add margin bottom utilities
    $options[] = [
        'value' => 'mb10',
        'label' => "Margin Bottom 10px",
        'type'  => "preset",
        'css'   => ".mb10{margin-bottom:10px}"
    ];
    
    $options[] = [
        'value' => 'mb20',
        'label' => "Margin Bottom 20px",
        'type'  => "preset",
        'css'   => ".mb20{margin-bottom:20px}"
    ];
    
    // Add padding utilities
    $options[] = [
        'value' => 'p15',
        'label' => "Padding 15px",
        'type'  => "preset",
        'css'   => ".p15{padding:15px}"
    ];
    
    return $options;
}
```

#### Example 2: Create a Complete Custom Preset Group

```php
add_filter('greenshift_preset_classes', 'my_custom_preset_group');
function my_custom_preset_group($options) {
    $custom_group = array(
        'label'   => esc_html__('My Custom Utilities', 'my-theme'),
        'options' => array(
            [
                'value' => 'text-center',
                'label' => "Text Center",
                'type'  => "preset",
                'css'   => ".text-center{text-align:center}"
            ],
            [
                'value' => 'flex-center',
                'label' => "Flex Center",
                'type'  => "preset",
                'css'   => ".flex-center{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center}"
            ],
            [
                'value' => 'shadow-sm',
                'label' => "Small Shadow",
                'type'  => "preset",
                'css'   => ".shadow-sm{box-shadow:0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05)}"
            ]
        )
    );
    
    // Merge with existing options
    $options[] = $custom_group;
    return $options;
}
```

#### Example 3: Register a Custom CSS Framework (Classes Without Inline CSS)

```php
add_filter('greenshift_framework_classes', 'register_tailwind_classes');
function register_tailwind_classes($options) {
    return array(
        array(
            'label'   => esc_html__('Tailwind Spacing', 'my-theme'),
            'options' => array(
                ['value' => 'm-0', 'label' => "Margin 0", 'type' => "framework"],
                ['value' => 'm-1', 'label' => "Margin 0.25rem", 'type' => "framework"],
                ['value' => 'm-2', 'label' => "Margin 0.5rem", 'type' => "framework"],
                ['value' => 'p-0', 'label' => "Padding 0", 'type' => "framework"],
                ['value' => 'p-1', 'label' => "Padding 0.25rem", 'type' => "framework"],
                ['value' => 'p-2', 'label' => "Padding 0.5rem", 'type' => "framework"]
            )
        ),
        array(
            'label'   => esc_html__('Tailwind Flex', 'my-theme'),
            'options' => array(
                ['value' => 'flex', 'label' => "Display Flex", 'type' => "framework"],
                ['value' => 'flex-col', 'label' => "Flex Column", 'type' => "framework"],
                ['value' => 'items-center', 'label' => "Items Center", 'type' => "framework"],
                ['value' => 'justify-center', 'label' => "Justify Center", 'type' => "framework"]
            )
        )
    );
}
```

#### Example 4: Add Border Presets with Visual Styles

```php
add_filter('greenshift_border_preset_classes', 'my_border_presets');
function my_border_presets($options) {
    $options[] = [
        'value' => 'gs_border_elegant',
        'label' => "Border Elegant",
        'css'   => ".gs_border_elegant{border:1px solid #00000012}",
        'type'  => "preset"
    ];
    
    $options[] = [
        'value' => 'gs_border_thick',
        'label' => "Border Thick",
        'css'   => ".gs_border_thick{border:3px solid currentColor}",
        'type'  => "preset"
    ];
    
    $options[] = [
        'value' => 'gs_border_dashed',
        'label' => "Border Dashed",
        'css'   => ".gs_border_dashed{border:2px dashed #ccc}",
        'type'  => "preset"
    ];
    
    return $options;
}
```

---

### Summary of Key Differences

| Aspect | Preset Type | Framework Type |
|--------|-------------|----------------|
| `type` value | `"preset"` | `"framework"` |
| CSS property | **Required** - CSS is inline | **Omitted** - CSS loaded separately |
| Use case | Self-contained utility classes | External CSS framework integration |
| Filter for groups | `greenshift_preset_classes` | `greenshift_framework_classes` |

### Important Notes

1. **For AI-generated content:** When programmatically creating blocks, Greenshift recommends adding the `CSSRender` attribute set to `1` for all `wp:greenshift-blocks/element` blocks to enable server-side style generation.

2. **Core Framework Integration:** Can be enabled through Greenshift settings (Interface tab). When using Core Framework, ensure font size equals 100% in settings, and be aware that Greenshift local attributes will override Core Framework system items.

3. **Responsive breakpoints:** Style attributes support arrays with up to 4 values for desktop, tablet, mobile landscape, and mobile portrait. Use `null` to skip specific breakpoints.

# React Router for WordPress - Complete Documentation

## Overview

React Router for WordPress is a WordPress plugin enabling integration of React applications into WordPress sites, supporting both frontend and backend deployment scenarios.

## Core Functionality

The plugin allows developers to build React-based applications within WordPress environments. It provides a custom Gutenberg block called "React Router" that renders React applications directly on pages.

## Installation

1. Upload plugin files to `/wp-content/plugins/` or install via WordPress plugin interface
2. Activate through the Plugins screen in WordPress admin

## Development Structure

**Entry Point:** The `src/App.js` file serves as the primary application entry point where developers write React components.

**Styling:**
- `editor.scss` - Frontend-exclusive styles
- `style.scss` - Styles applying to both frontend and backend environments

## Available Development Commands

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `npm run build` | Compiles the application for production |
| `npm run start` | Initiates development server |
| `npm run hot-start` | Launches hot-reload development with file watching |

**Configuration Note:** The hot-start feature requires setting the correct WordPress site URL in `gulpfile.js` (siteUrl variable).

## Adding Apps to Pages

Integration is straightforward: open the WordPress block editor and insert the React Router block to render your application.

## Project Metadata

- **Version:** 0.1.0 (initial release)
- **Compatibility:** Tested up to WordPress 6.6
- **License:** GPL-2.0-or-later
- **Language Composition:** JavaScript (47.7%), PHP (28.1%), CSS (20.6%), SCSS (3.6%)
- **Repository Stats:** 7 stars, 1 fork, 2 commits

The plugin appears designed for developers combining WordPress backend capabilities with modern React frontend development patterns.

# Greenshift CSS Framework Registration Guide

## Filter Hooks for Preset Classes

Greenshift provides dedicated filters to inject classes into existing preset groups:

1. `greenshift_style_preset_classes`
2. `greenshift_interaction_preset_classes`
3. `greenshift_spacing_preset_classes`
4. `greenshift_shadow_preset_classes`
5. `greenshift_border_preset_classes`
6. `greenshift_background_preset_classes`
7. `greenshift_data_preset_classes`

## Preset Class Structure

A preset class requires this array format:

```php
[
   'value'  => 'gs_border_elegant',
   'label'  => "Border Elegant",
   'css'    => ".gs_border_elegant{border:1px solid #00000012}",
   'type'   => "preset"
]
```

## Framework Class Structure

Framework classes omit CSS (loaded independently):

```php
[
   'value' => 'mb10',
   'label' => "Margin Bottom 10px",
   'type'  => "framework"
]
```

## Registering in Existing Groups

Add to style presets using the filter callback pattern:

```php
add_filter('greenshift_style_preset_classes', 'custom_style_classes');
function custom_style_classes($options){
   $options[] = [
      'value'=> 'mb10',
      'label'=> "Margin Bottom 10px",
      'type' => "preset",
      'css' => ".mb10{margin-bottom:10px}"
   ];
   return $options;
}
```

## Creating Custom Groups

**Preset Group Registration:**

```php
add_filter('greenshift_preset_classes', 'custom_preset_group');
function custom_preset_group($options){
   return array(
      array(
         'label'   => esc_html__('Custom Presets', 'textdomain'),
         'options' => array(
            ['value' => 'mb10', 'label' => "Margin Bottom 10px", 
             'type'  => "preset", 'css' => ".mb10{margin-bottom:10px}"],
            ['value' => 'mb20', 'label' => "Margin Bottom 20px", 
             'type'  => "preset", 'css' => ".mb20{margin-bottom:20px}"]
         )
      )
   );
}
```

**Framework Group Registration:**

```php
add_filter('greenshift_framework_classes', 'custom_framework_group');
function custom_framework_group($options){
   return array(
      array(
         'label'   => esc_html__('Custom Framework', 'textdomain'),
         'options' => array(
            ['value' => 'mb10', 'label' => "Margin Bottom 10px", 'type' => "framework"],
            ['value' => 'mb20', 'label' => "Margin Bottom 20px", 'type' => "framework"]
         )
      )
   );
}
```

## Core Framework Integration

Enable through Greenshift settings (Interface tab) to inject Core Framework utility classes. Key considerations:

- Ensure font size equals 100% in Core Framework settings
- Greenshift local attributes override Core Framework system items
- Check Typography (headings) and Components (avatars) for conflicts
- Remove unwanted items via the three-dot menu and delete option
```

   133→if(!function_exists('greenShiftAi_block_script_assets')){
   134→	function greenShiftAi_block_script_assets($html, $block)
   135→	{
   136→		// phpcs:ignore
   137→	
   138→		if(!is_admin()){
   139→			if ($block['blockName'] == 'greenshift-blocks/smartcode') {
   140→				if(!empty($block['attrs']['scriptcontent'])){
   141→					wp_enqueue_script('gs-smartcode-ai-code');
   142→					$scriptcontent = wp_strip_all_tags( $block['attrs']['scriptcontent']);
   143→					wp_add_inline_script( 'gs-smartcode-ai-code', $scriptcontent );
   144→				}
   145→				if(!empty($block['attrs']['csscontent'])){
   146→					wp_enqueue_style('gs-smartcode-ai-code');
   147→					$csscontent = wp_strip_all_tags( $block['attrs']['csscontent']);
   148→					wp_add_inline_style( 'gs-smartcode-ai-code', $csscontent );
   149→				}
   150→				if(!empty($block['attrs']['prettyform'])){
   151→					wp_enqueue_style('gs-smartcode-ai-prettyform');
   152→				}
   153→				if(!empty($block['attrs']['phpcontent']) && !empty($block['attrs']['executeSnippet']) && !empty($block['attrs']['snippetID'])){
   154→					$html = str_replace('gspb-smartcode">', 'gspb-smartcode">'.greenshift_smartcodeai_render_snippet_shortcode(array('id'=>$block['attrs']['snippetID'])), $html);
   155→				}
   156→			}
   157→		}
   158→	
   159→		return $html;
   160→	}
   161→}

   216→if(!function_exists('gspb_gutenbergAI_is_parent_active')){
   217→	function gspb_gutenbergAI_is_parent_active()
   218→	{
   219→		$active_plugins = get_option('active_plugins', array());
   220→
   221→		if (is_multisite()) {
   222→			$network_active_plugins = get_site_option('active_sitewide_plugins', array());
   223→			$active_plugins         = array_merge($active_plugins, array_keys($network_active_plugins));
   224→		}
   225→
   226→		foreach ($active_plugins as $basename) {
   227→			if (
   228→				0 === strpos($basename, 'greenshift-animation-and-page-builder-blocks/')
   229→			) {
   230→				return true;
   231→			}
   232→		}
   233→
   234→		return false;
   235→	}
   236→}

   399→function gspb_ai_lab_register_route()
   400→{
   401→
   402→	register_rest_route(
   403→		'greenshift/v1',
   404→		'/model_ai/',
   405→		array(
   406→			array(
   407→				'methods'             => 'GET',
   408→				'callback'            => 'gspb_get_ai_data',
   409→				'permission_callback' => function () {
   410→					return current_user_can('manage_options');
   411→				},
   412→				'args' => array(),
   413→			),
   414→		)
   415→	);
   416→
   417→	register_rest_route(
   418→		'greenshift/v1',
   419→		'/get-php-preview/',
   420→		array(
   421→			array(
   422→				'methods'             => 'GET',
   423→				'callback'            => 'gspb_get_php_preview_data',
   424→				'permission_callback' => function () {
   425→					return current_user_can('manage_options');
   426→				},
   427→				'args' => array(
   428→					'id' => array(
   429→						'type' => 'string',
   430→						'required' => true,
   431→					)
   432→				),
   433→			),
   434→		)
   435→	);
   436→}

   438→function gspb_get_php_preview_data(WP_REST_Request $request)
   439→{
   440→	$id = intval($request->get_param('id'));
   441→	$result = '';
   442→
   443→	if($id){
   444→		$result = greenshift_smartcodeai_render_snippet_shortcode(array('id'=>$id));
   445→	}
   446→	return json_encode($result);
   447→}

   449→function gspb_get_ai_data(WP_REST_Request $request)
   450→{
   451→	$openaiapikey = $openaiapimodel = '';
   452→	if (gspb_gutenbergAI_is_parent_active()) {
   453→		$sitesettings = get_option('gspb_global_settings');
   454→		$openaiapikey = (!empty($sitesettings['openaiapi'])) ? esc_attr($sitesettings['openaiapi']) : '';
   455→		$claudeapikey = (!empty($sitesettings['claudeapi'])) ? esc_attr($sitesettings['claudeapi']) : '';
   456→		$deepseekapikey = (!empty($sitesettings['deepseekapi'])) ? esc_attr($sitesettings['deepseekapi']) : '';
   457→		$openaiapimodel = (!empty($sitesettings['openaiapimodel'])) ? esc_attr($sitesettings['openaiapimodel']) : 'gpt-4.1-mini';
   458→		$geminiapikey = (!empty($sitesettings['geminiapi'])) ? esc_attr($sitesettings['geminiapi']) : '';
   459→	} else {
   460→		$openaiapikey = get_option('greenshift_smartcode_openaiapikey');

   509→function greenshift_register_ai_setting() {
   510→

   520→
   521→function greenshift_smartcodeai_render_snippet_shortcode($atts) {
   522→	// extract shortcode attributes
   523→	$atts = shortcode_atts(
   524→	  	array(
   525→			'id' => '',
   526→	  	),
   527→	  	$atts,
   528→	  	'gspb_codesnippet'
   529→	);
   530→
   531→	$content = '';
   532→  
   533→	// get post or page by ID
   534→	$post_id = intval($atts['id']);
   535→	if(!$post_id){
   536→		return $content;
   537→	}
   538→	$post = get_post($post_id);
   539→  
   540→	// if post exists, return title
   541→	if (is_object($post) && $post->post_status == 'publish' && $post->post_type == 'gscodesnippet') {
   542→	  	$content = $post->post_content;
   543→		  if($content){
   544→			preg_match('/<code(?:\s+[a-z]+="[^"]*")*>(.*?)<\/code>/ims', $content, $matches);
   545→			if(empty($matches[1])){
   546→				return $content;
   547→			}
   548→			$content = htmlspecialchars_decode($matches[1]);
   549→			if($content){
   550→				if (preg_match("#<\?php(.*)\?>#s", $content, $matches)) {
   551→		
   552→					ob_start();
   553→		
   554→					try {
   555→						eval('?>' . $content. '<?php');
   556→		
   557→					} catch (Exception $e) {
   558→						if (is_user_logged_in()) {
   559→							echo esc_html($e->getMessage());
   560→						}
   561→						else {
   562→							esc_html_e("An error occurred!", 'greenshift_smart-code-ai');
   563→						}
   564→					}
   565→		
   566→					$content = ob_get_clean();
   567→				}
   568→			}
   569→		}
   570→	} 
   571→	return '<div class="gs-executed">'.$content.'</div>';
   572→}
   573→  
   574→// register shortcode
   575→add_shortcode('gspb_codesnippet', 'greenshift_smartcodeai_render_snippet_shortcode');

    24→export default function edit(props) {

    31→		textContent,
    32→		enableSpecificity,
    33→		color,
    34→		unitArray,
    35→		interactionLayers,
    36→		anchor,
    37→		icon
    38→	} = props.attributes;
    39→
    40→	// Generate Unique ID for The Block. Id is always unique for each block.
    41→	useEffect(() => {
    42→		gspb_setBlockId(props, 2);
    43→	}, []);
    44→
    45→	// Set Root class for the block (stored in localId). Root class can be similar in several blocks
    46→	useEffect(() => {
    47→		if (id != null) {
    48→			if (props.attributes.localId && props.attributes.localId == id) {
    49→				//do nothing
    50→			} else {
    51→				if (props.attributes.staticLocalId && props.attributes.localId) {
    52→					//do nothing
    53→				} else {
    54→					props.setAttributes({ localId: id });
    55→				}
    56→			}
    57→		}
    58→	}, [id]);
    59→
    60→	// Render Icon Box
    61→	let iconBox = icon ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(icon)) : null;
    62→
    63→	//Render Animation Properties for Animation Panel support
    64→	const animationRef = useRef();
    65→	let AnimationProps = {};
    66→	AnimationProps = AnimationRenderProps(animation, interactionLayers);
    67→
    68→	// Get Dynamic Data Attributes for Dynamic Data Panel support (Class panel)
    69→	let DynamicDataAttributes = getDataAttributesfromDynamic(props);
    70→
    71→	// Set Block Props for the block

    73→		"data-gspb-block-id": props.attributes.id,
    74→		className: `gspb-selector-element ${localId ? localId : ''}`,
    75→		ref: animationRef,
    76→		...DynamicDataAttributes,
    77→		...AnimationProps
    78→	});
    79→
    80→	let css_selector_by_user = '.' + localId;
    81→	let final_css = '';
    82→	// Get Final CSS from Dynamic Local Classes
    83→	final_css = getFinalCssFromDynamicLocalClasses(props, final_css);
    84→
    85→	let local_css = '';
    86→	// Get CSS from Style Attributes
    87→	if (styleAttributes) {
    88→		local_css = getCssFromStyleAttributes(styleAttributes, css_selector_by_user, local_css, enableSpecificity);
    89→	}
    90→	if (local_css != '') {
    91→		final_css += local_css;
    92→	}
    93→
    94→	// Animation CSS Generation
    95→	final_css = aos_animation_cssGen(
    96→		animation,
    97→		css_selector_by_user,
    98→		final_css,
    99→		props
   100→	);
   101→
   102→	// Example for Device Related custom CSS Generation
   103→	final_css = gspb_cssGen(

   105→		['font-size'],
   106→		[

   109→				[(unitArray && unitArray[1]) ? unitArray[1] : null],
   110→				[(unitArray && unitArray[2]) ? unitArray[2] : null],
   111→				[(unitArray && unitArray[3]) ? unitArray[3] : null],
   112→			],
   113→		],
   114→		final_css
   115→	);
   116→
   117→	// Example for non Device Related custom CSS Generation
   118→	final_css = gspb_cssGen(
   119→		css_selector_by_user,
   120→		['color'],
   121→		[color],
   122→		final_css
   123→	);
   124→
   125→	let ElementTag = 'div';
   126→
   127→	if (anchor) {
   128→		blockProps.id = anchor;
   129→	}
   130→
   131→	// Get Final CSS for Editor. Attach editor-styles-wrapper to the block in editor.
   132→	let editor_css = final_css;
   133→	editor_css = gspb_convert_styles_for_editor(editor_css);
   134→
   135→	// Set Stored CSS
   136→	gspb_Css_Final(id, final_css, props);
   137→
   138→	return (
   139→		<>
   140→			<AnimationWrapper attributes={props.attributes} props={props} animationExtRef={animationRef}>
   141→				{props.isSelected &&
   142→					<>
   143→						<Inspector {...props} />
   144→						<BlockToolBar {...props} />
   145→					</>
   146→				}
   147→				<ElementTag {...blockProps}>
   148→					<RichText
   149→						tagName={'span'}
   150→						placeholder={__("Greenlight - Page-Building Gutenberg Blocks", 'greenlightaddon')}
   151→						value={textContent}
   152→						onChange={(value) => {
   153→							props.setAttributes({ textContent: value });
   154→						}}

    12→	}
    13→
    14→	public function init_handler(){

    21→	public function render_block($settings, $inner_content, $block)
    22→	{
    23→		$block = (is_array($block)) ? $block : $block->parsed_block;
    24→		$html = $inner_content;
    25→
    26→		// Support for Hide on Frontend option
    27→		if(!empty($block['attrs']['styleAttributes']['hideOnFrontend_Extra'])){
    28→			if(!is_admin()){
    29→				return '';
    30→			}
    31→		}
    32→
    33→		//Polyfills
    34→		if(!empty($block['attrs']['styleAttributes']['animationTimeline'])){
    35→			wp_enqueue_script('scroll-view-polyfill');
    36→		}
    37→		if(!empty($block['attrs']['styleAttributes']['anchorName'])){
    38→			wp_enqueue_script('anchor-polyfill');
    39→		}
    40→
    41→		if(!empty($block['attrs']['textContent'])){
    42→			if(strpos($block['attrs']['textContent'], '{{') !== false){
    43→				//Apply dynamic placeholders to text content
    44→				$html = gl_dynamic_placeholders($html);
    45→			}
    46→		}
    47→
    48→		return $html;
    49→	}
    50→}

# React-Rooter index.js Source Code

Based on the GitHub page content, here is the complete source code for `src/index.js`:

```javascript
/**
 * Registers a new block provided a unique name and an object defining its behavior.
 *
 * @see https://developer.wordpress.org/block-editor/reference-guides/block-api/block-registration/
 */
import { registerBlockType } from '@wordpress/blocks';

/**
 * Lets webpack process CSS, SASS or SCSS files referenced in JavaScript files.
 * All files containing `style` keyword are bundled together. The code used
 * gets applied both to the front of your site and to the editor.
 *
 * @see https://www.npmjs.com/package/@wordpress/scripts#using-css
 */
import './style.scss';

/**
 * Internal dependencies
 */
import Edit from './edit';
import save from './save';
import metadata from './block.json';

/**
 * Every block starts by registering a new block type definition.
 *
 * @see https://developer.wordpress.org/block-editor/reference-guides/block-api/block-registration/
 */
registerBlockType( metadata, {
	/**
	 * @see ./edit.js
	 */
	edit: Edit,

	/**
	 * @see ./save.js
	 */
	save,
} );
```

## How Block Registration Works

The initialization follows a standard WordPress block pattern where `registerBlockType` accepts metadata configuration plus an object defining editor behavior (the `Edit` component) and front-end rendering (the `save` function).

# React Component Mounting in view.js

Based on the GitHub page content, here's the complete source code for `view.js`:

```javascript
import React from 'react';
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import App from './App';

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const blocks = document.querySelectorAll('[id^="react-rooter-"]');
  blocks.forEach((block) => {
    const root = createRoot(block);
    root.render(React.createElement(App));
  });
});
```

## How It Works

This script initializes React components on the frontend through a straightforward approach:

1. **Event Listener**: Waits for the DOM to fully load before executing
2. **Element Selection**: Targets all HTML elements with IDs beginning with `"react-rooter-"`
3. **Root Creation**: Uses React 18's `createRoot()` API to establish a root for each matched element
4. **Component Rendering**: Mounts the `App` component into each identified container

The approach allows multiple React application instances to coexist on a single page, each independently mounted to designated DOM nodes. This pattern is useful for integrating React components into existing server-rendered templates or plugin systems.
```

# edit.js Source Code Analysis

Based on the GitHub repository content provided, here is the complete source code for `edit.js`:

```javascript
import { useBlockProps } from '@wordpress/block-editor';
import { useEffect } from '@wordpress/element';
import App from './App';
import './editor.scss';

export default function Edit(props) {
	const { attributes, setAttributes, clientId } = props;
	const { blockId } = attributes;

	useEffect(() => {
		if (!blockId) {
			const newBlockId = `react-rooter-${clientId.slice(0, 8)}`;
			setAttributes({ blockId: newBlockId });
		}
	}, []);

	const blockProps = useBlockProps();
	blockProps.id = blockId || 'react-rooter-init';

	return (
		<div {...blockProps}>
			<App />
		</div>
	);
}
```

## Component Structure

This editor component is a **WordPress block edit interface** that manages a React block. The structure includes:

- **Imports**: Dependencies from WordPress's block editor and element libraries, plus a custom App component
- **Props destructuring**: Extracts attributes, setAttributes callback, and clientId from props
- **Block ID initialization**: Uses a lifecycle hook to generate a unique identifier combining the prefix "react-rooter" with the first 8 characters of the client ID
- **Block properties**: Applies WordPress block properties and sets the DOM element ID
- **Render**: Returns a div wrapping the App component
```

     1→# Greenlight Addon - WordPress Gutenberg Block Extension
     2→
     3→A powerful WordPress plugin that extends Gutenberg blocks with Greenlight's high-quality library of components. This addon provides advanced styling, animation, interactions, dynamic placeholders and class system and customization capabilities for WordPress block development on top of Greenshift or GreenLight PRO plugins. 
     4→
     5→## 🚀 Features
     6→
     7→- **Advanced Block Styling**: Dynamic CSS generation with device-specific responsive controls
     8→- **Class System**: AOS (Animate On Scroll) animations with interaction layers
     9→- **Animation Support**: AOS (Animate On Scroll) animations with interaction layers
    10→- **Rich Text Editing**: Enhanced text editing with RichText component
    11→- **Icon Integration**: SVG icon support with customizable attributes
    12→- **Dynamic Data Attributes**: Support for dynamic content and class management
    13→- **Interactions**: Support for dynamic content and class management
    14→- **Performance Optimized**: Efficient CSS generation and block rendering
    15→
    16→## 📋 Requirements
    17→
    18→- WordPress 5.0+ (Gutenberg support)
    19→- Greenlight Builder plugin or Greenshift plugin (parent plugin)
    20→- Node.js 14+ (for development)
    21→- PHP 7.4+
    22→
    23→## 🛠️ Installation
    24→
    25→1. Clone this repository to your WordPress plugins directory:
    26→```bash
    27→git clone https://github.com/wpsoul/greenlightaddon.git
    28→cd greenlightaddon
    29→```
    30→
    31→2. Install dependencies:
    32→```bash
    33→npm install
    34→```
    35→
    36→3. Build the plugin:
    37→```bash
    38→npm run build
    39→```
    40→
    41→4. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin panel
    42→
    43→## 🏗️ Development
    44→
    45→### Available Scripts
    46→
    47→- `npm start` - Start development mode with hot reloading
    48→- `npm run build` - Build production assets
    49→- `npm run lint:js` - Lint JavaScript files
    50→- `npm run lint:style` - Lint CSS files
    51→
    52→### Project Structure
    53→
    54→```
    55→greenlightaddon/
    56→├── src/
    57→│   └── blocks/
    58→│       └── example/
    59→│           ├── edit.js          # Block editor component
    60→│           ├── inspector.js     # Block inspector controls
    61→│           ├── save.js          # Block save component
    62→│           └── index.js         # Block registration
    63→├── build/                       # Compiled assets
    64→├── greenlightaddon.php         # Main plugin file
    65→└── package.json                # Dependencies and scripts
    66→```
    67→
    68→## 🔧 Block Editor Component (edit.js) Explained
    69→
    70→The `edit.js` file is the core component that handles the block's appearance and functionality in the WordPress editor. Here's a detailed breakdown of its components:
    71→
    72→### Dependencies
    73→
    74→#### WordPress Dependencies
    75→- `wp.i18n` - Internationalization support
    76→- `wp.element` - React hooks (useRef, useEffect)
    77→- `wp.blockEditor` - Gutenberg block editor components (RichText, useBlockProps)
    78→
    79→#### Greenlight Dependencies
    80→- `gspblib.utilities` - Core utility functions for block management
    81→- `gspblib.helpers` - Helper functions for CSS generation
    82→- `gspblib.components` - Reusable UI components
    83→- `gspblib.collections` - Animation and wrapper components
    84→
    85→### Key Components Breakdown
    86→
    87→#### 1. Block ID Management
    88→```javascript
    89→useEffect(() => {
    90→    gspb_setBlockId(props, 2);
    91→}, []);
    92→```
    93→- Generates unique IDs for each block instance
    94→- Ensures proper block identification and styling
    95→
    96→#### 2. Local ID Management
    97→```javascript
    98→useEffect(() => {
    99→    if (id != null) {
   100→        // Logic for setting localId based on block ID. Used for root class. While id is unique, localId can be shared between several blocks
   101→        props.setAttributes({ localId: id });
   102→    }
   103→}, [id]);
   104→```
   105→- Manages CSS class names for styling
   106→- Allows similar styling across multiple blocks
   107→
   108→#### 3. Animation System
   109→```javascript
   110→const animationRef = useRef();
   111→let AnimationProps = AnimationRenderProps(animation, interactionLayers);
   112→```
   113→- Provides AOS (Animate On Scroll) animation support
   114→- It has stagger support, hover actions, svg animations, etc
   115→- Handles interaction layers for complex animations
   116→- Uses refs for animation targeting
   117→
   118→#### 4. Dynamic Data Attributes
   119→```javascript
   120→let DynamicDataAttributes = getDataAttributesfromDynamic(props);
   121→```
   122→- Supports dynamic content integration
   123→- Enables class panel functionality
   124→- Allows runtime attribute modification
   125→- In blockrender folder, find server side rendering for block with gl_dynamic_placeholders that handle dynamic placeholders for content
   126→
   127→#### 5. CSS Generation System
   128→
   129→##### Dynamic Local Classes
   130→```javascript
   131→final_css = getFinalCssFromDynamicLocalClasses(props, final_css);
   132→```
   133→- Generates CSS from dynamic class system
   134→
   135→##### Style Attributes
   136→```javascript
   137→if (styleAttributes) {
   138→    local_css = getCssFromStyleAttributes(styleAttributes, css_selector_by_user, local_css, enableSpecificity);
   139→}
   140→```
   141→- Converts style attributes to CSS
   142→- Supports specificity control for CSS priority
   143→
   144→##### Animation CSS
   145→```javascript
   146→final_css = aos_animation_cssGen(animation, css_selector_by_user, final_css, props);
   147→```
   148→- Generates AOS animation CSS
   149→- Handles keyframe animations and transitions
   150→
   151→##### Device-Responsive CSS
   152→```javascript
   153→final_css = gspb_cssGen(
   154→    css_selector_by_user,
   155→    ['font-size'],
   156→    [
   157→        [
   158→            [(unitArray && unitArray[0]) ? unitArray[0] : null],
   159→            [(unitArray && unitArray[1]) ? unitArray[1] : null],
   160→            [(unitArray && unitArray[2]) ? unitArray[2] : null],
   161→            [(unitArray && unitArray[3]) ? unitArray[3] : null],
   162→        ],
   163→    ], // [desktop, tablet, mobile, mobile-small]
   164→    final_css
   165→);
   166→```
   167→- gspb_cssGen is used to generate css for specific css option. First parameter - selector where to apply styles, second - array of css options, third - array of values for desktop, tablet, mobile, and mobile-small breakpoints. 
   168→##### Static CSS Properties
   169→```javascript
   170→final_css = gspb_cssGen(
   171→    css_selector_by_user,
   172→    ['color'],
   173→    [colorValue],
   174→    final_css
   175→);
   176→```
   177→- Handles non-responsive CSS properties
   178→- Supports any CSS property with single values
   179→
   180→#### 6. Block Props Configuration
   181→```javascript
   182→let blockProps = useBlockProps({
   183→    "data-gspb-block-id": props.attributes.id,
   184→    className: `gspb-selector-element ${localId ? localId : ''}`,
   185→    ref: animationRef,
   186→    ...DynamicDataAttributes,
   187→    ...AnimationProps
   188→});
   189→```
   190→- Combines all block attributes and properties + some extra attributes for editor.
   191→- Sets up proper CSS classes and data attributes
   192→- Integrates animation and dynamic data support
   193→
   194→#### 7. Editor-Specific Styling
   195→```javascript
   196→let editor_css = gspb_convert_styles_for_editor(final_css);
   197→```
   198→- Converts frontend CSS for editor compatibility
   199→- Ensures consistent styling between editor and frontend
   200→
   201→#### 8. Component Rendering
   202→
   203→##### Animation Wrapper
   204→```javascript
   205→<AnimationWrapper attributes={props.attributes} props={props} animationExtRef={animationRef}>
   206→```
   207→- Wraps the entire block for animation support
   208→- Provides animation context and lifecycle management
   209→
   210→##### Inspector and Toolbar
   211→```javascript
   212→{props.isSelected && (
   213→    <>
   214→        <Inspector {...props} />
   215→        <BlockToolBar {...props} />
   216→    </>
   217→)}
   218→```
   219→- Shows block controls only when block is selected
   220→- Provides customization interface for users
   221→
   222→##### Rich Text Component
   223→```javascript
   224→<RichText
   225→    tagName={'span'}
   226→    placeholder={__("Greenlight - Page-Building Gutenberg Blocks", 'greenlightaddon')}
   227→    value={textContent}
   228→    onChange={(value) => {
   229→        props.setAttributes({ textContent: value });
   230→    }}
   231→/>
   232→```
   233→- Provides rich text editing capabilities
   234→- Supports formatting, links, and other text features
   235→- Handles content updates and persistence
   236→
   237→
   238→##### Style Tabs
   239→```javascript
   240→<AttributeTabs
   241→    attributeName="styleAttributes"
   242→    {...props}
   243→    defaultTab={''}
   244→    includes={['typography', 'color', 'spacing', 'shadow', 'border', 'position', 'size', 'layout', 'effects', 'csstransform', 'responsive']} svgcolors={true} selfAlign={"both"}
   245→/>
   246→```
   247→- Provides rich style control
   248→- You can select which panels to include
   249→- If you don't want to have tabs, you can put only one option in includes parameter
   250→
   251→##### SVG Icon Viewer
   252→```javascript
   253→{iconBox && (
   254→    <SVGViewer attributeName="icon" blockProps={blockProps} {...props} />
   255→)}
   256→```
   257→- Renders SVG icons for Icon component
   258→- Integrates with the block's styling system
   259→
   260→##### Dynamic CSS Injection
   261→```javascript
   262→{editor_css && (
   263→    <style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: editor_css }} />
   264→)}
   265→```
   266→- Injects generated CSS directly into the editor
   267→- Ensures real-time styling updates in editor
   268→
   269→## 🎨 Customization
   270→
   271→### Adding New CSS Properties
   272→
   273→To add support for new CSS properties, use the `gspb_cssGen` helper:
   274→
   275→```javascript
   276→// For responsive properties
   277→final_css = gspb_cssGen(
   278→    css_selector_by_user,
   279→    ['margin-top', 'padding-bottom'],
   280→    [responsiveValues],
   281→    final_css
   282→);
   283→
   284→// For static properties
   285→final_css = gspb_cssGen(
   286→    css_selector_by_user,
   287→    ['background-color'],
   288→    [backgroundColor],
   289→    final_css
   290→);
   291→```
   292→
   293→### Adding New Attributes
   294→
   295→1. Add the attribute to your block's `attributes` object in `index.js`
   296→2. Destructure it in the `edit.js` component
   297→3. Use it in your CSS generation or component logic
   298→4. Add corresponding controls in `inspector.js`
   299→
   300→## 📚 API Reference
   301→
   302→### Greenlight Library Functions
   303→
   304→- `gspb_setBlockId(props, prefix)` - Sets unique block ID
   305→- `getDataAttributesfromDynamic(props)` - Gets dynamic data attributes
   306→- `getFinalCssFromDynamicLocalClasses(props, css)` - Generates CSS from dynamic classes
   307→- `getCssFromStyleAttributes(attributes, selector, css, specificity)` - Converts style attributes to CSS
   308→- `aos_animation_cssGen(animation, selector, css, props)` - Generates animation CSS
   309→- `gspb_cssGen(selector, properties, values, css)` - Generates custom CSS
   310→- `gspb_convert_styles_for_editor(css)` - Converts CSS for editor compatibility
   311→- `gspb_Css_Final(id, css, props)` - Stores final CSS
   312→
   313→### Components
   314→
   315→- `AnimationWrapper` - Wraps blocks with animation support
   316→- `BlockToolBar` - Provides block toolbar controls
   317→- `SVGViewer` - Renders SVG icons
   318→- `BlpgeColorPicker` - Special Color component, use instead of core color component of gutenberg for extra features (more presets, color picker, variables)
   319→- `UnitControl` - Improved UnitControl, use instead of core UnitControl for extra features (right mouse click for variable selection)
   320→- `Devices` - Device Selector
   321→

    25→export default function OpenAIResponse ( props ) {

    36→            }else{
    37→                button.innerHTML = "<i class='rhicon rhi-clone'></i> Copy to code area";
    38→            }

    40→          }, 2000);

    42→
    43→    function copyToClipboard(text) {
    44→        const textarea = ownerDocument.createElement('textarea');
    45→        textarea.value = text;
    46→        textarea.setAttribute('readonly', '');
    47→        textarea.style.position = 'absolute';
    48→        textarea.style.left = '-9999px';
    49→        ownerDocument.body.appendChild(textarea);
    50→        textarea.select();
    51→        ownerDocument.execCommand('copy');
    52→        ownerDocument.body.removeChild(textarea);
    53→    }

    65→                    hljs.highlightElement(codeEle);

    67→            });

# React-Rooter save.js Source Code

Based on the GitHub page content, here's the complete source code for `save.js`:

```javascript
import { useBlockProps } from '@wordpress/block-editor';

export default function save({ attributes }) {
  const { blockId } = attributes;
  const blockProps = useBlockProps.save();
  blockProps.id = blockId || 'react-rooter-init';

  return (
    <div {...blockProps} />
  );
}
```

## How It Works

This React component handles the saved output of the block. The save function:

1. **Imports block utilities** - Uses WordPress's `useBlockProps` from the block-editor package
2. **Extracts the blockId** - Retrieves the custom block identifier from component attributes
3. **Applies block properties** - Calls `useBlockProps.save()` to get standard WordPress block markup properties
4. **Sets a unique ID** - Assigns either the custom blockId or defaults to 'react-rooter-init'
5. **Returns JSX markup** - Renders a simple div with spread block properties

The minimal output (a div with an ID) suggests the actual React content is likely mounted to this element dynamically via JavaScript, rather than being server-rendered in the saved HTML.
